description_en: Unbinds the external identity provider from a specified workspace and cleans up users synchronized by that identity provider. The unbinding is an asynchronous operation. After the API returns, you can track the progress by querying the status through GetIdentityProvider
description_zh: 解绑指定工作空间的外部身份提供商，并清理由该身份提供商同步产生的用户。解绑为异步操作，接口返回后可通过 GetIdentityProvider 查询 status 跟踪进展
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore delete-identity-provider --workspace-id ws-123456 --identity-provider-type DingTalk --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteIdentityProvider

parameters.help_en: The type of the external identity provider to unbind. Valid values: DingTalk, Feishu. The value must match the currently bound type
parameters.help_zh: 待解绑的外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu，取值必须与当前绑定的类型一致
parameters.name: identity_provider_type

data.description_en: The binding information of the external identity provider after the unbinding operation is accepted
data.description_zh: 解绑操作受理后的外部身份提供商绑定信息

identityProviderType.description_en: The type of the external identity provider. Valid values: DingTalk, Feishu
identityProviderType.description_zh: 外部身份提供商类型。可选值：DingTalk、Feishu

status.description_en:
The status. Valid values:
CONFIGURED: The configuration has been accepted and is waiting for the user pool to be provisioned.
SYNCING: Organization members are being synchronized.
SYNCED: Organization member synchronization is complete.
READY: The binding is in effect.
SYNC_FAILED: Organization member synchronization failed.
UPDATING: The configuration is being updated.
UPDATE_FAILED: Configuration update failed.
DISCONNECTING: The unbinding is in progress.
DISCONNECT_FAILED: The unbinding failed
status.description_zh: 状态。CONFIGURED（配置已受理，等待开通用户池）、SYNCING（正在同步组织成员）、SYNCED（组织成员同步完成）、READY（绑定已生效）、SYNC_FAILED（组织成员同步失败）、UPDATING（正在更新配置）、UPDATE_FAILED（更新配置失败）、DISCONNECTING（正在解绑）、DISCONNECT_FAILED（解绑失败）

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
